legacy_payload.best_for: 以和纸纹理底、靛蓝唯一强调、细规则与开放框表达日式沉静、有触感、高级克制的编辑气质
legacy_payload.visual_direction: calm Japanese washi-paper editorial, subtle paper fiber texture with low-opacity dots, generous whitespace, thin horizontal and vertical rules, open rectangular frames, small indigo dots at line endpoints, asymmetric columns, one restrained pale-indigo soft wash behind a hero word, cropped product and craft photos with negative space, Muji-like restraint, no text

canvas.background: paper white #F5F5F5 with subtle washi fiber grain
canvas.composition: asymmetric columns, thin rules, open frames, spacious grids

color_palette.accent: indigo #2C3E50 — the only active accent (rules, emphasis, diagram nodes)
color_palette.neutral: mist lavender #D5D0DB and wisteria gray #B3AFCB as rare soft fields
color_palette.rule: keep most pages to paper + charcoal + gray + indigo; palette reserves only as translucent single-page mood accents

typography.title: serif title (Georgia / 思源宋体), editorial warmth
typography.body: clean sans body (Microsoft YaHei 微软雅黑 / 思源黑体), calm leading
typography.labels: monospace sparingly for section labels / folios / source notes (Consolas / 等宽)
typography.text_quality: quiet, reflective, readable against subtle texture

layout_patterns: open-frame column: asymmetric columns divided by thin rules, no heavy cards
hero-word soft wash: a pale indigo/lavender low-opacity field behind one hero word or diagram node
thin-rule captioned photo: cropped photo in a geometric frame with a thin caption rule
cover = washi ground + serif title + one indigo endpoint dot and hairline
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Use #2C3E50 as the only active accent; soft glow only as a restrained local wash, never glowing UI.
negative_prompt: no bokeh, orbs, neon glow or glass panels
no heavy card grids, thick borders or filled icon badges
no strong drop shadows or glossy gradients
no repeated centered title + bullets layout

visual_elements.allowed: washi fiber texture, thin rules, open frames, small indigo dots, outline icons (max 1-3/page)
visual_elements.avoid: heavy cards, thick borders, blobs, emoji, dark stock photos

rendering_constraints: Subtle paper texture that never fights body text.
Indigo as the single active accent; reserves stay rare.
